children: Anthropic plans to pay directors at least $325,000 in restricted stock and $100,000 in cash each year, plus $400,000 in restricted stock when they take their seats. The annual shares will vest-becoming the director's to hold or sell-over the subsequent year. Sign-on shares will vest over four years.

Directors holding committee or other board posts will get additional cash: $75,000 for the board's chair, $40,000 for the audit-committee chair, $30,000 for other committee chairs and $15,000 to $20,000 for sitting on a committee.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
